title: Split-Zero cohomology: conductor inverses and four-endpoint kernel control

source_cuts.scope: The accepted 97-page current reader gives complete written proofs of a sharper original common-kernel ceiling, exact residue and primary-ideal maps, the conductor degree flag, the theta primitive and corrected minimum section, and a literal finite conductor inverse with its original quotient and exterior Gram transfer. The main simple-quartet lane retains m=1, k=4l+1 with l>=1, q=(k+1)^2, all original period branches in the proved range, and Gamma orders 1,k. The uniform limsup ceiling is 32 log(25 log3/(4pi)), below 25.02078097650, retaining the preceding KAF bound in the finite pointwise minimum. The finite coefficient inverse applies at degree D<=q-1 and is paired with the original minimum-remainder Grams at the four larger source endpoints. Its scalar logarithmic O(q) estimate retains the rank factor, giving O(kq) exterior loss; no leading value or unique limit is assigned. All preceding kernel-frame, action-defect, all-multiplicity geometry and full source proofs remain. The seventeen-file source package includes two fully updated receiving sources, eleven full TeX files, the current and preceding readers, one current prompt, provenance/validation, and the exact combined PR32 source and proof record. PR32 recorded CI checked 33 modules and 56 selected targets at its stated pinned source; this publication performs no new Lean execution or merge. Complete owner and independent proof/source/PDF acceptance is reused. Receiver compilation proves source closure, not receiver-PDF visual review. Only source-map account locators are transported with separate original/public identities. No RH conclusion is asserted.
